question: Why can the binary three-star boundary have rank31, and how can an edge change create the fourth relation needed for Conway?

setup.matrix: T=3I-Gamma-K on34 labels meeting centres0,1,2; mates c xor1; 8K_yz=3|y intersect z|+mate_incidence(y,z)-2.
setup.forced_kernel: The three star indicator vectors are independent and annihilated by T. Thus rank<=31. A producer-certified PSD rank31 seed is strictly positive on their31-dimensional orthogonal complement H.
setup.conway_requirement: The full84-label residual spectral matrix for an actual SRG(99,14,1,2) has rank30. Every principal block must have rank<=30. Hence one additional relation on the34 labels is necessary.
setup.limitation: Three forced relations explain why31 is the maximal local rank. They do not prove that all locally admissible binary configurations have rank31. Neither rank31 nor rank30 characterizes asymmetry.

weighted_relation.notation: Choose a hypothetical extra kernel vector q orthogonal to all three star indicators. Put z_c=sum_{y containing c}q_y and s=sum_y q_y. Let p={0,2}, pprime={1,2}.
weighted_relation.equation: 24 q_{cd}-8 sum_{w adjacent to {c,d}}q_w = 3(z_c+z_d)+z_{c xor1}+z_{d xor1}-2s.
weighted_relation.adjacent_overlaps_case: If Gamma_p,pprime=1, both overlap degrees in Gamma equal2. With other neighbours r,s, 4(q_p-q_pprime)=q_r-q_s.
weighted_relation.special_case_only: If all14 z_c vanish, then Kq=0 and the extra relation reduces to Gamma q=3q. A general extra relation need not have all14 z_c zero.

rectangle_switch.update: Take four distinct vertices u,r,v,s, a=e_u-e_r, b=e_v-e_s. DeltaGamma=sigma(a b^t+b a^t), sigma=+1 or-1. For sigma=+1, add uv and rs, remove us and rv.
rectangle_switch.star_preservation: Because a,b are independent, DeltaGamma annihilates the three star indicators iff a and b are each orthogonal to them. Equivalently u,r have the same centre membership, and v,s have the same centre membership.
rectangle_switch.cells: Three nonsingleton cells have sizes11,11,10; the two overlap vertices are singleton cells. No such rectangle can move either overlap row. All degrees remain fixed.
rectangle_switch.count: Cross-cell shapes:55*55+2*55*45=7975. Within-cell shapes:3*(C(11,4)+C(11,4)+C(10,4))=2610. Total10585. Each geometry has at most one binary-legal sign.
rectangle_switch.local_admissibility: After binary legality, test only common-neighbour caps affected by the four changed rows in the full49-vertex boundary. Other caps and degrees persist from the producer-certified seed.
rectangle_switch.scope: This exhausts single rectangle switches preserving the three star relations. It does not exhaust longer trades, simultaneous switches, or changes to overlap rows.

exact_response.metric: Let G=T^+ be the inverse of T on H. Put alpha=a^tGa, beta=b^tGb, gamma=a^tGb. Then alpha,beta>0 and alpha*beta>gamma^2.
exact_response.proof: Whitening by T^{-1/2} on H gives I-sigma(x y^t+y x^t), x=T^{-1/2}a, y=T^{-1/2}b. Its two nonunit eigenvalues are1-sigma*gamma plus/minus sqrt(alpha*beta). The larger is strictly positive. Thus the sign of F exactly gives the sign of the smaller eigenvalue.

outcomes.F_negative: T' has exactly one negative eigenvalue

exact_response.new_kernel: At F=0, q=G(sigma*beta*a+(1-sigma*gamma)*b) is a nonzero extra kernel vector orthogonal to the three stars.
exact_response.integer_evaluation: Use an integer basis Z of H. For M=8T, compute (Z^t M Z)^(-1)=N/d once. Then G=8 Z N Z^t/d. F has integer numerator(d-sigma*gamma_num)^2-alpha_num*beta_num. No eigenvalue tolerance or repeated seed-rank computation is used.
exact_response.precondition: The seed PSD/rank31 certification is supplied by its producer. Candidate repairs additionally need T<=7Pi_SS (the ambient complementary Gram) and all50 outside columns; rank30 alone does not produce a Conway graph.

implementation.own_primitive_checks: Six exact cases on T=c*P_H for c=1,2,3 and both signs exercise negative, zero and positive determinant responses. At zero, the newly constructed fourth relation is checked. All passed in1.08seconds.
